purpose: Authored parchment-scroll inventory artwork for all 58 existing elemental spells.

prompts.fire:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas of FIRE spell-scroll inventory item icons for a Minecraft fantasy RPG resource pack.
Make a TRANSPARENT PNG sprite atlas, landscape aspect 4:3, exactly 4 columns and 3 rows of equally sized square cells. No visible grid, no text, no labels, no UI panels. Each cell contains ONE complete isolated item, precisely centered with 12% empty padding on all four sides. Row 3 cells 3 and 4 must be completely empty transparent. No overlaps between cells. Keep all items upright front view with very slight thickness shading; identical inventory scale.
Art direction: richly hand-crafted high resolution pixel art, like an exquisite RPG relic rendered at 128x128 native pixels and enlarged with crisp pixels. Strong dark brown edge clusters, warm ivory parchment, curled cylindrical top and bottom scroll rolls, polished aged bronze/gold finials, charcoal leather bindings, ruby gemstone fasteners. Visible layered paper edges, tiny engraved metal filigree, and ember-orange luminous spell seals. Warm metallic highlights and dark material creases. High contrast central symbol occupies at least one third of each parchment and must remain recognizable at 32x32 inventory size. Dramatic colored light must live ON the object; clean transparent negative space. This is a PHYSICAL parchment scroll, not a square skill button, not a book, not a trading card, not a flat rectangle in a frame. No soft blurry effects, no atmospheric backdrop, no cast shadow on a ground plane, no large aura. Use fully opaque parchment and metal, crisp alpha silhouette.
Rarity progression: BASIC = compact scroll, simple bronze ends and one small ruby pin. RARE = carved gold ends, red leather corner straps and two ruby details. EPIC = elaborate flared gold finials, black-red layered backing, fine circular golden sigil and three bright ruby accents. LEGENDARY = luxurious wider scroll with crown-like gold scroll-end ornaments, winglike metal flourishes, ruby centerpiece and hanging gold seal charm, clearly more ornate than Basic. Keep unique large spell glyphs visually separate from small decorations.
Exact cell contents in reading order:
row 1 col 1 FIREBALL, BASIC: a bright spherical fireball with an orange trailing flame.
row 1 col 2 FLAME BURST, BASIC: a six-point exploding orange sunburst.
row 1 col 3 BURNING GROUND, RARE: three flame tongues rising from a fractured earth line.
row 1 col 4 FLAME DASH, RARE: a diagonal fiery arrow with three horizontal motion trails.
row 2 col 1 INFERNO SPEAR, RARE: a tall blazing spearhead and narrow dark shaft.
row 2 col 2 MAGMA ERUPTION, EPIC: a triangular erupting volcano with molten fissures.
row 2 col 3 HELLFIRE CHAIN, RARE: three interlocked burning chain links.
row 2 col 4 SCORCHING VORTEX, EPIC: a curling spiral of flame surrounding a dark center.
row 3 col 1 METEOR RAIN, LEGENDARY: three falling ember meteors with long diagonal tails.
row 3 col 2 PHOENIX REBIRTH, LEGENDARY: a radiant golden phoenix with outstretched wings and red flame tail.
row 3 col 3 and col 4: empty transparent cells.
Consistent rendering and evenly spaced aligned cell centers; respect the exact count ten scrolls. No letters, numbers, writing, watermark, background, extra loose props or diagram.
